main.description: The way out of the bin that restoring is not. An owner of the context deletes for good everything one bin entry holds: the documents, their author chips, the comments on them, and the files nothing else points at. A bin entry that holds a poll is refused, since a vote's record is nobody's to delete, and so is one that holds a group or an event.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such document, or a context the caller may not read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller does not own the context.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The document is not a bin entry: it is live, or went to the bin as part of another.

errors.name: NotPurgeable
errors.description: The bin entry holds a poll, a group or an event (HTTP 409).
